definitions.explanation: Black clothing worn when attending funerals or memorial services. In Japan, this typically means a black suit or black dress with minimal accessories.

examples.japanese: {喪服|もふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I wore mourning clothes and attended the funeral.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{喪服|もふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It was such sudden news that there was no time to prepare mourning clothes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{喪服|もふく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧や⟦アクセサリー→アクセサリー：01761_akusesarii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, mourning clothes are basically black, and shiny materials or accessories are avoided.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喪服|もふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ (wear mourning clothes)
- {喪服|もふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧ (prepare mourning clothes)
- {喪服|もふく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧ (change into mourning clothes)

Japanese mourning attire ({喪服|もふく}) is strictly black. For men, a black suit with a white shirt and black tie; for women, a black dress or suit. ⟦{真珠|しんじゅ}→真珠：19873_shinju⟧ (pearls) are the only acceptable accessory. Many adults keep a set of {喪服|もふく} ready at all times for unexpected funerals.
